en: Color postcard showing a large medieval hilltop fortress with red-tiled roofs and multiple towers rising above dense evergreen forest, viewed through pine branches against a bright blue sky. The reverse side has multilingual captions identifying the site, a vertical imprint of the Romanian National Tourism Office, a publisher mark, and a postage stamp (40 BANI) with a raspberry illustration.
